title: EC-Council DSE
summary: EC-Council DSE is a professional certification offered by EC-Council. This independent study guide covers all 10 course modules: Application Development Concepts, Application Security Fundamentals, Introduction to DevOps, Introduction to DevSecOps, Introduction to DevSecOps Management Tools, Introduction to DevSecOps Code and CI CD Tools, Introduction to DevSecOps Pipelines, Introduction to DevSecOps CI CD Testing and Assessments, Implementing DevSecOps Testing & Threat Modeling, Implementing DevSecOps Monitoring Feedback. Every module has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam, written as realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each module the way the job asks for it.
objectives: Introduction to DevSecOps Code and CI CD Tools
Introduction to DevSecOps CI CD Testing and Assessments
attributionNote: EC-Council certification content is an independent study guide written for CyberPulseAcademy and is not affiliated with or endorsed by EC-Council.
